title: Same Linda. Same Betty. Same Toy. 👯
caption:
Separated at birth. Met at 39. Freakishly alike. 🤯
Tag your twin 👇
sources: Segal N. L. (2012) 'Born Together, Reared Apart: The Landmark Minnesota Twin Study' (Harvard University Press) (the 'Jim twins', Jim Lewis and Jim Springer, reunited 1979)
Bouchard T. J. et al. (1990) 'Sources of human psychological differences: the Minnesota Study of Twins Reared Apart', Science 250: 223-228
People magazine / Smithsonian Magazine (1980, 2014) coverage of the Jim twins (Linda, Betty, sons James Alan/Allan, dogs named Toy, Chevrolets, Pass-a-Grille beach)
